Definition: Works out a workable solution to a problem, comparing options and giving reasons for the choice.
Includes: Breaking problems down; comparing options; choosing and justifying an approach; deciding what AI can help with
Example fresher tasks: Solve an unseen case or bug; choose between two approaches

Definition: Breaks down information, spots patterns and inconsistencies, and draws conclusions the evidence supports.
Includes: Reading information; spotting errors and gaps; checking AI output; stating assumptions
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Producing a solution (C01); working with datasets (R06)
Example fresher tasks: Find inconsistencies in a report; check an AI answer

Definition: Explains ideas, reasoning and results so the intended audience understands them and can act on them.
Includes: Writing; speaking; presenting; describing problems precisely to people and AI tools
Example fresher tasks: Explain own work; write a status update; present findings

Definition: Shares information, divides work and builds on others' input to reach a shared outcome.
Includes: Sharing information; dividing work; resolving disagreement about the work; handing off and reviewing work
Example fresher tasks: Pair task; resolve a disagreement with a developer or colleague

Definition: Learns unfamiliar tools or methods and uses them correctly, and changes approach when requirements or conditions change.
Includes: Learning from documentation; handling changed requirements; picking up new tools
Example fresher tasks: Use a new tool from its documentation; adjust to a mid-task change

Definition: Delivers what was committed, on time, takes responsibility for its quality (including AI-produced parts), and flags problems early.
Includes: Meeting commitments; flagging delays; owning mistakes; checking own work
Example fresher tasks: Multi-day task with check-ins; report a delay before the deadline

Definition: Writes, reads and organises code that solves a given problem, including reviewing and correcting AI-generated code.
Includes: Core language features; basic data structures and algorithms; organising code; handling errors in own code
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Debugging existing code, Git, code review (R02); multi-part design (R11)
Role families: Software & IT; Quality & Testing; Data & Analytics; Infrastructure
Example fresher tasks: Build an API endpoint; write a script; fix AI-generated code

Definition: Uses version control, tests their own code, debugs existing code and takes part in code review.
Includes: Git; unit tests; debugging existing code; code review; build pipelines
Example fresher tasks: Fix a bug in unfamiliar code; open a pull request; review a teammate's code

Definition: Designs tables and writes the queries an application uses, and keeps data correct.
Includes: Table design; SQL for applications; data integrity; indexes (basic)
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Querying data to answer a business question (R06)
Role families: Software & IT; Data & Analytics; Quality & Testing
Example fresher tasks: Write queries for an API; design a simple schema; check data behind a screen

Definition: Builds the screens users see and use, on web or mobile, so they match the design, work on all devices and are accessible.
Includes: Web and mobile UI; responsive layouts; UI components; connecting screens to APIs; accessibility
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Visual and UX design decisions (R18, R19)
Example fresher tasks: Build a screen from a design; make a layout responsive; show loading and error states
Typical tools: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Angular, Flutter, Kotlin, Swift

Definition: Structures a system of several parts so it meets requirements and constraints and can be maintained.
Includes: Splitting a system into parts; choosing interfaces between them; trade-offs
Example fresher tasks: Sketch the parts of a small service and justify them

Definition: Applies basic security practices and recognises common security risks in systems and code.
Includes: Secure coding basics; access control; common attacks; handling security alerts
Example fresher tasks: Spot a security flaw in code; triage a security alert

Definition: Sets up, runs and deploys software on operating systems, networks and cloud services.
Includes: Linux; networking basics; cloud services; deployment; monitoring
Example fresher tasks: Deploy a service to the cloud; configure a server; read monitoring alerts
Typical tools: Linux, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes

Definition: Diagnoses and fixes hardware, software and network problems reported by users, and records the fix.
Includes: Diagnosing issues step by step; fixing or escalating; documenting in tickets
Example fresher tasks: Resolve a laptop or network issue; work a support ticket
Typical tools: ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, remote desktop tools

Definition: Designs and runs tests on a product to find defects, reports them clearly, and confirms fixes.
Includes: Test cases; exploratory and risk-based testing; defect reporting; regression; checking AI-generated tests
Example fresher tasks: Write test cases from a user story; log a reproducible bug; retest a fix

Definition: Cleans, analyses and charts data to answer a question, and checks that the results are correct.
Includes: Cleaning data; querying; analysis; charts and dashboards; validating results
Role families: Data & Analytics; Business & Consulting; Finance; Marketing; Operations
Example fresher tasks: Build a dashboard; find why sales fell; clean a messy dataset
Typical tools: Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, Tableau

Definition: Uses basic statistics to judge whether a pattern in data is real or chance.
Includes: Descriptive statistics; comparing groups; significance basics; sampling
Example fresher tasks: Judge whether an A/B test result is real

Definition: Builds, evaluates and explains simple predictive models, and judges when a model can be trusted.
Includes: Preparing features; training models; evaluating accuracy; explaining results
Example fresher tasks: Build and evaluate a churn prediction model

Definition: Builds and maintains the processes that move and transform data from sources to where it is used.
Includes: ETL and ELT; scheduling; data quality checks; data warehouses
Example fresher tasks: Build a pipeline that loads daily sales data

Definition: Understands users' needs and designs flows, wireframes and prototypes that let them complete tasks easily.
Includes: User research; user flows; wireframes; prototypes; usability testing; accessibility
Example fresher tasks: Map a checkout flow; run a usability test with 5 users

Definition: Creates layouts and visual assets using type, colour and imagery that fit the brand and purpose.
Includes: Layout; typography; colour; brand assets; design systems
Example fresher tasks: Design a social media post; create high-fidelity screens

Definition: Finds out what users or a business need, maps how a process works, and writes clear requirements and improvements.
Includes: Gathering requirements; user stories; process mapping; gap analysis; process improvement
Role families: Business & Consulting; Software & IT; Quality & Testing; Operations
Example fresher tasks: Write user stories; map an order process; list requirement questions

Definition: Explains how a business makes money, who its customers and competitors are, and how its functions connect, and applies this to a business question.
Includes: Business models; customers; competitors; value and pricing basics; how departments connect
Role families: Business & Consulting; Data & Analytics; Sales; Marketing; Finance; HR
Example fresher tasks: Explain what drives a company's revenue; judge whether an idea is worth pursuing

Definition: Breaks work into tasks, plans timelines, tracks progress and follows up until completion.
Includes: Task planning; scheduling; tracking; status reporting; follow-ups
Example fresher tasks: Build a project plan; run a weekly status tracker
Typical tools: Excel, Jira, Asana, MS Project, Trello

Definition: Reads financial statements, builds financial models and explains what the numbers mean for a decision.
Includes: Financial statements; ratios; financial models; valuation basics; budgeting
Example fresher tasks: Build a three-statement model; analyse a company's ratios

Definition: Records transactions, reconciles accounts and prepares basic financial statements following accounting and tax rules.
Includes: Bookkeeping; reconciliations; GST and TDS basics; month-end closing
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Analysing statements for decisions (R22); audit checks (R24)
Example fresher tasks: Record entries; reconcile a bank statement; prepare a GST return

Definition: Checks records and processes against rules and standards, and documents what was found.
Includes: Audit sampling; controls testing; compliance checks; working papers
Example fresher tasks: Test a sample of invoices; document an audit finding

Definition: Finds prospects, uncovers their needs through questions, presents value, handles objections and agrees a next step.
Includes: Prospecting; discovery conversations; pitching; objection handling; follow-up; using CRM
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Price and terms negotiation (R25); service after sale (R34)
Example fresher tasks: Make a discovery call; handle an objection; qualify a lead
Typical tools: Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator

Definition: Reaches agreements on price, terms or scope that work for both sides, within given limits.
Includes: Preparing positions; trading concessions; closing
Example fresher tasks: Negotiate a discount within limits in a role-play

Definition: Plans marketing activity for a target audience, sets measurable goals and judges results.
Includes: Target audience; positioning; campaign plans; goals and KPIs
Example fresher tasks: Write a campaign plan for a product launch

Definition: Runs and improves campaigns on digital channels, and reads their performance data.
Includes: SEO; social media; paid ads; email campaigns; channel metrics
Example fresher tasks: Set up a paid ad campaign; improve a page's search ranking
Typical tools: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, Mailchimp, SEMrush

Definition: Writes and produces content for a specific audience and purpose, in the brand's voice.
Includes: Copywriting; blogs; social posts; scripts; editing AI drafts
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Explaining one's own work (C03); visual design (R19)
Example fresher tasks: Write a blog post; edit an AI draft into brand voice
Typical tools: Google Docs, WordPress, Canva, AI writing tools

Definition: Collects and analyses information about markets, customers and competitors to answer a business question.
Includes: Surveys; interviews; competitor analysis; secondary research
Excludes (belongs elsewhere): Using the findings for business decisions (R08)
Example fresher tasks: Size a market; compare three competitors

Definition: Finds, screens and moves candidates through the hiring process, keeping candidates and managers informed.
Includes: Sourcing; screening; scheduling; candidate communication; tracking
Example fresher tasks: Source candidates for a role; screen resumes against requirements

Definition: Runs HR processes such as onboarding, employee records, attendance and payroll inputs, following policy and law.
Includes: Onboarding; records; attendance and leave; payroll inputs; HR policies
Example fresher tasks: Onboard a new joiner; prepare payroll inputs
Typical tools: HRMS tools (Darwinbox, Keka, SAP SuccessFactors), Excel

Definition: Plans and tracks stock, orders and deliveries so the right items are available at the right time and cost.
Includes: Inventory planning; purchase orders; vendor follow-up; logistics tracking
Example fresher tasks: Plan reorder quantities; track late shipments

Definition: Resolves customer queries and complaints on phone, chat or email, following process, and records each case.
Includes: Handling queries; complaint resolution; escalation; ticket records
Example fresher tasks: Handle an angry customer in a role-play; close a chat ticket

Definition: Applies mechanical engineering principles to calculations, designs and practical problems at fresher level.
Includes: Mechanics; thermodynamics; materials; manufacturing processes
Example fresher tasks: Calculate loads on a part; choose a material

Definition: Applies electrical and electronics principles to calculations, circuits and practical problems at fresher level.
Includes: Circuits; power systems; electronics; instrumentation
Example fresher tasks: Read a circuit diagram; size a cable

Definition: Applies civil engineering principles to calculations, site work and practical problems at fresher level.
Includes: Structures; materials; surveying; estimation
Example fresher tasks: Prepare a quantity estimate; check a site measurement

Definition: Reads and creates engineering drawings and models to the required standards.
Includes: Reading drawings; creating 2D and 3D models; tolerances
Example fresher tasks: Create a part drawing from a sketch

Definition: Inspects products and processes against standards, records defects and finds their likely causes.
Includes: Inspection; measurement; defect records; root-cause basics; safety rules
Example fresher tasks: Inspect a batch; complete a root-cause analysis
Typical tools: Measuring instruments, Six Sigma tools, Excel
